a.lede: Amazon has added a camera to its Echo Studio speaker as part of its big Echo refresh.
a.title: The Amazon Echo Studio's new camera can check on your dog or tell you how to play 'Monopoly'

b.lede: Amazon's other new devices include an upgraded Echo Dot, an Echo Studio with visual intelligence features, and the Echo Show 16.
b.title: Amazon debuts the Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time smart clock, plus other upgraded devices
